subject: Help with error message for distsamp

messages.author: 9333910a9aa76f5d
messages.subject: Help with error message for distsamp
parts:
Hello all, I am at a loss for how to move forward with this error message that produced from my code below:

dist.HN   <- distsamp(~1 ~1, umf, keyfun = "halfnorm", output="density", unitsOut="ha")

ERROR MESSAGE:
Error in optim(starts, nll, method = method, hessian = se, ...) : 
  initial value in 'vmmin' is not finite

What could the problem be? Would it possibly have to do with earlier code? Thanks

messages.author: 4f80e1927b0757cb
messages.subject: Re: Help with error message for distsamp
parts:
Hi,

It's quite hard to diagnose this type of error without being able to look at the data and code in detail. However, my first guess would be that the issue is caused by the units of your input data. If you are using meters as the input unit for your distance breaks and transect length (if applicable), and your survey area extends out pretty far (say hundreds of meters) then the default initial value for sigma, which will be relatively small, may not work and the optimization will break as you see here. One easy way to test if this is the case is to change your input units to km. So if your distance breaks were 100m, 200m, 300m they would become 0.1, 0.2, 0.3 km which will be easier for the optimization process to handle. You'd have to change your transect lengths to km as well.

Ken

Hey thanks for the reply Ken, is this enough code to look into the problem further? The distances aren't very large (not hundreds of meters), so it might be something else wrong. 

distData <- df.species[,c("PointTransect", "Distance", "Visit")]
distCol <- "Distance"
transectNameCol <- "PointTransect"
dist.breaks <-  seq(0,100,by=50)
head(dist.breaks)
occasionCol <- "Visit"

y <- formatDistData(distData, distCol, transectNameCol, dist.breaks, occasionCol)
head(y)


numPrimary <- 3     #Three Visits

yearlySiteCovs <- data.frame(PointTransect = rep(row.names(y), each = numPrimary))
head(yearlySiteCovs)

yearlySiteCovs$Visit <- rep(1:3,366)
yearlySiteCovs[, c("jday","Grass_Height", "Temp_C","Wind_Condition","minutes.after.sunrise")] <- NA

for (v in c("jday","Grass_Height", "Temp_C","Wind_Condition","minutes.after.sunrise")){
  for(s in  1:nrow(yearlySiteCovs)){
    pt = yearlySiteCovs$PointTransect[s]
    vis = yearlySiteCovs$Visit[s]
    yearlySiteCovs[s, v] <- round(mean(VWL_BirdAll[VWL_BirdAll$PointTransect == pt & VWL_BirdAll$Visit == vis, v]), 2)
    
  }
}

checkNaNs <- yearlySiteCovs %>% 
  filter(is.nan(jday))

yearlySiteCovs <- yearlySiteCovs[, - 1]
y

covs <- merge(data.frame(PointTransect = row.names(y)), CLI_SiteCovariates[, c(5:29,33)], by = "PointTransect", all.x = T, all.y = F)

area <-pi*100^2/100^2 #area in ha

area

siteCovs = data.frame(covs, area)
head(siteCovs)
rownames(siteCovs) <- siteCovs$PointTransect
siteCovs2 <- siteCovs[, - 1] #remove PointTransect column now that it is sorted
head(siteCovs2)


umf <- unmarkedFrameDS(y, siteCovs2, dist.breaks = c(0,50,100,50,100,50,100), numPrimary,  survey = "point", unitsIn = "m")
summary(umf)


scsc <- scale(siteCovs(umf)[,1:25])
scs <- cbind(scsc,siteCovs(umf)[,26])

siteCovs(umf) <- scs

summary(umf) 

str(umf)

messages.author: 4f80e1927b0757cb
messages.subject: Re: Help with error message for distsamp
parts: Looking at your code for constructing the umf:
umf <- unmarkedFrameDS(y, siteCovs2, dist.breaks = c(0,50,100,50,100,50,100), numPrimary,  survey = "point", unitsIn = "m")

dist.breaks should be strictly increasing but it isn't here. Maybe it's supposed to be c(0, 50, 100)?

Also distsamp() can't handle multiple visits to each point but it looks like you do have multiple visits. I think you probably want to look at gdistsamp() instead.

Ken
